```{r setup}
res   <- readRDS(file.path("..", "results", "pipeline_results.rds"))
flags <- res$qc_flags
vt    <- res$vt
drug  <- res$drug

# Show a flag table, or a short note if there are no flags
show_flags <- function(f) {
  if (nrow(f) == 0) {
    cat("No flags.\n")
  } else {
    f$value <- signif(f$value, 3)
    knitr::kable(f[, c("check", "severity", "subject", "session", "region",
                       "value", "message")], row.names = FALSE)
  }
}
```

## Summary

All QC flags raised by the pipeline, by stage and check.
*exclude* = row removed from the analysis; *warning* = kept, but reported.

```{r summary}
if (nrow(flags) == 0) {
  cat("No flags.\n")
} else {
  knitr::kable(as.data.frame.matrix(table(paste(flags$stage, flags$check),
                                          flags$severity)))
}
```

Rows excluded from the analysis: **`r sum(vt$qc_exclude)`** of `r nrow(vt)`
VT estimates and **`r sum(drug$qc_exclude)`** of `r nrow(drug)` drug samples.

## Stage 2 – Input data

### VT estimates

```{r vt-se, fig.cap = "Relative SE of VT per region. Dashed line: exclusion threshold."}
op <- par(mar = c(8, 4, 1, 1))
boxplot(VT_SE_pct ~ region, data = vt, las = 2, log = "y",
        xlab = "", ylab = "VT SE (%)")
abline(h = 25, lty = 2)
par(op)
```

```{r vt-flags, results = "asis"}
show_flags(flags[flags$stage == "qc_vt", ])
```

### Drug samples

```{r drug-flags, results = "asis"}
show_flags(flags[flags$stage == "qc_drug", ])
```

## Optional – TACs and arterial input

```{r tac-qc, results = "asis"}
tf <- flags[flags$stage %in% c("qc_tacs", "qc_plasma"), ]
if (is.null(res$plasma)) {
  cat("*Not run. Use `run_pipeline(tac_qc = TRUE)` to check the TACs and the",
      "arterial input behind the VT estimates.*\n")
} else {
  show_flags(tf)
}
```

```{r plasma-plot, eval = !is.null(res$plasma) && any(res$plasma$qc_flagged), fig.width = 7, fig.height = 4.5, fig.cap = "Arterial input curves with a flagged sample (black, flagged sample in red); all other curves in grey."}
pl  <- res$plasma[res$plasma$plasma_parent_kBq_mL > 0, ]
cid <- paste(pl$subject, pl$session)
bad <- unique(cid[pl$qc_flagged])

plot(pl$time_min, pl$plasma_parent_kBq_mL, log = "y", type = "n",
     ylim = c(0.1, max(pl$plasma_parent_kBq_mL)),
     xlab = "Time (min)", ylab = "Parent in plasma (kBq/mL)")
for (k in setdiff(unique(cid), bad)) {
  lines(pl$time_min[cid == k], pl$plasma_parent_kBq_mL[cid == k], col = "grey80")
}
for (k in bad) {
  lines(pl$time_min[cid == k], pl$plasma_parent_kBq_mL[cid == k], lwd = 1.5)
}
points(pl$time_min[pl$qc_flagged], pl$plasma_parent_kBq_mL[pl$qc_flagged],
       pch = 19, col = "red")
legend("topright", bty = "n", legend = bad, lty = 1, lwd = 1.5, cex = 0.8)
```
```{r tac-plots, eval = !is.null(res$tacs), fig.width = 9, fig.height = 24, fig.cap = "TACs per subject (rows) and session (columns). Circles: measured TAC; lines: 2TCM fit from the VT estimates (dashed: VT excluded by QC). One colour per region."}
tc  <- res$tacs
tc$t_mid <- (tc$frame_start_min + tc$frame_end_min) / 2
regs <- sort(unique(tc$region))
cols <- setNames(hcl.colors(length(regs), "Dark 3"), regs)
excl <- paste(vt$subject, vt$session, vt$region)[vt$qc_exclude]

op <- par(mfrow = c(length(unique(tc$subject)), 3), mar = c(3, 3.5, 2, 0.5),
          mgp = c(2, 0.6, 0), oma = c(4, 0, 0, 0))
for (s in sort(unique(tc$subject))) {
  for (ses in c("baseline", "block1", "block2")) {
    d <- tc[tc$subject == s & tc$session == ses, ]
    plot(NA, xlim = range(tc$t_mid), ylim = range(tc$activity_kBq_mL),
         xlab = "Time (min)", ylab = "kBq/mL", main = paste(s, ses), cex.main = 0.9)
    for (r in regs) {
      dr <- d[d$region == r, ]
      points(dr$t_mid, dr$activity_kBq_mL, col = cols[r], pch = 1, cex = 0.5)
      lines(dr$t_mid, dr$fitted, col = cols[r],
            lty = ifelse(paste(s, ses, r) %in% excl, 2, 1))
    }
  }
}
par(fig = c(0, 1, 0, 1), oma = c(0, 0, 0, 0), mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0), new = TRUE)
plot.new()
legend("bottom", legend = regs, col = cols, pch = 1, lty = 1, ncol = 5, bty = "n",
       cex = 0.9)
par(op)
```


## Stage 5 – Lassen fits

One Lassen plot per subject and block session:
y = VT~baseline~ − VT~block~, x = VT~baseline~; slope = occupancy, x-intercept = V~ND~.
```{r lassen-table}
fits  <- res$lassen$fits
pairs <- res$lassen$pairs
lf    <- flags[flags$stage == "qc_lassen", ]

# All flag names per fit (fit-level and point-level), as one text column
fit_key  <- paste(fits$subject, fits$session)
flag_key <- paste(lf$subject, lf$session)
fits$flags <- vapply(fit_key, function(k) paste(unique(lf$check[flag_key == k]),
                                                collapse = ", "), character(1))

tab <- data.frame(subject   = fits$subject,
                  session   = fits$session,
                  regions   = fits$n_regions,
                  occupancy = sprintf("%.2f ± %.2f", fits$occupancy, fits$occupancy_se),
                  VND       = round(fits$VND, 2),
                  R2        = round(fits$r_squared, 2),
                  excluded  = ifelse(fits$qc_exclude, "yes", ""),
                  flags     = fits$flags)
knitr::kable(tab, row.names = FALSE)
```
```{r lassen-plots, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 13, fig.cap = "Lassen plots. Red points: flagged as Lassen outliers. Grey panel title: fit excluded."}
outliers <- paste(lf$subject, lf$session, lf$region)[lf$check == "lassen_outlier"]

op <- par(mfrow = c(5, 4), mar = c(4, 4, 2.5, 1), mgp = c(2.2, 0.7, 0))
for (i in seq_len(nrow(fits))) {
  f <- fits[i, ]
  p <- pairs[pairs$subject == f$subject & pairs$session == f$session, ]
  is_out <- paste(p$subject, p$session, p$region) %in% outliers

  plot(p$VT_base, p$delta, pch = 19, col = ifelse(is_out, "red", "black"),
       xlim = c(0, max(pairs$VT_base)), ylim = range(c(0, pairs$delta)),
       xlab = "VT baseline", ylab = "VT base − VT block",
       main = sprintf("%s %s: occ %.2f, R² %.2f", f$subject, f$session,
                      f$occupancy, f$r_squared),
       col.main = ifelse(f$qc_exclude, "grey50", "black"), cex.main = 0.9)
  abline(h = 0, col = "grey80")
  if (!is.na(f$occupancy)) abline(a = f$intercept, b = f$occupancy, col = "steelblue")
}
par(op)
```
```{r lassen-flags, results = "asis"}
show_flags(lf)
```


## Stage 7 – EC50 fit

Emax model: occupancy = occ~max~ · C / (C + EC50), one point per block scan.

```{r ec50-result}
er  <- res$ec50$result
ept <- res$ec50$points
ef  <- flags[flags$stage == "qc_ec50", ]
```
**EC50 = `r sprintf("%.1f", er$EC50_ng_mL)` ng/mL**
(95% CI `r sprintf("%.1f–%.1f", er$ci_low, er$ci_high)`),
occ~max~ fixed at `r er$occ_max`, `r er$n_scans` scans, residual SD
`r sprintf("%.3f", er$resid_sd)`.
```{r ec50-plot, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 5, fig.cap = "Occupancy vs plasma concentration. Solid line: Emax fit; dashed lines: curves at the 95% CI limits of EC50. Red points: flagged scans."}
flagged <- paste(ept$subject, ept$session) %in% paste(ef$subject, ef$session)
emax <- function(conc, ec50) er$occ_max * conc / (conc + ec50)
conc_grid <- 10^seq(log10(min(ept$conc_ng_mL) / 2), log10(max(ept$conc_ng_mL) * 2),
                    length.out = 200)

plot(ept$conc_ng_mL, ept$occupancy, log = "x", pch = 19,
     col = ifelse(flagged, "red", "black"), ylim = c(-0.1, 1.1),
     xlab = "Plasma drug concentration (ng/mL)", ylab = "Occupancy")
lines(conc_grid, emax(conc_grid, er$EC50_ng_mL), col = "steelblue", lwd = 2)
lines(conc_grid, emax(conc_grid, er$ci_low),  col = "steelblue", lty = 2)
lines(conc_grid, emax(conc_grid, er$ci_high), col = "steelblue", lty = 2)
abline(v = er$EC50_ng_mL, col = "grey60", lty = 3)
abline(h = c(0, er$occ_max), col = "grey85")
```
```{r ec50-loo, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 4.5, fig.cap = "Leave-one-out: change in EC50 when each scan is left out. Dashed lines: influence threshold."}
o <- order(ept$conc_ng_mL)
op <- par(mar = c(7, 4, 1, 1))
barplot(ept$loo_change_pct[o], names.arg = paste(ept$subject, ept$session)[o],
        las = 2, cex.names = 0.7, ylab = "Change in EC50 (%)",
        col = ifelse(flagged[o], "red", "grey70"),
        ylim = range(c(-20, 20, ept$loo_change_pct)))
abline(h = c(-15, 15), lty = 2)
par(op)
```
```{r ec50-flags, results = "asis"}
show_flags(ef)
```
